title.narrative: Emergency health response support for Ukrainian refugees in the Republic of Poland

description.narrative: Reducing the spread of disease among Ukrainian refugees in the Republic of Poland
Supporting the arrival of emergency medical aid for Ukrainian refugees in the Republic of Poland and its distribution to health centers and facilities

The project aims to support the emergency health response of Ukrainian refugees in Poland by purchasing and distributing emergency medical supplies in line with the needs assessments identified by the health authorities of the Republic of Poland and distributing them to health centers and facilities in the refugee areas, including: 1. Medical supplies for non-communicable diseases (diabetes, cardiovascular diseases, etc.). 2. Medical supplies for vaccine-preventable diseases including (measles, polio). 3. Medical supplies for HIV and tuberculosis. 4. Medical supplies for counter support
